title: TS-61 Relinquish the attempt lease when an infrastructure error escapes the executor
description: From TS-60: when an error escapes the TurnExecutor Lambda the turn waits for the 60 s attempt lease (ATTEMPT_LEASE_SECONDS) to expire and for the probe armed at claim to recover it and enqueue a new run (about 56 s observed); SQS is not the delay (TurnRuns visibility is 1800 s and lease renewal keeps it there). On an escaping infrastructure error (not a conditional-check rejection, not a deliberate park) the executor could relinquish its lease or shorten the message visibility so recovery starts immediately. Design choice: decide whether the benefit (about 50 s faster recovery after a rare infra error) is worth the added path; TS-60 already keeps the common transient conflict from escaping. Needs a cucumber scenario and mutation checks if taken.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14 (kept open): Not done on origin/develop: conversation/src/turn/executor.ts settleError rethrows an infrastructure error (line ~449) and relinquish is used only for the near-time-limit yield (turn/yield.ts). The question stays a design choice (about 50 s faster recovery after a rare infrastructure error versus an added path); see needs-owner-decision in the triage report.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing as not needed (YAGNI). The gain is about 50 s faster recovery after a rare infrastructure error, which does not justify an added lease-relinquish path. TS-60 already keeps the common transient conflict from escaping. Decision taken on the owner's instruction.

right_now_summary: The team decided not to add lease relinquishing because rare failures do not justify the extra path.
